spans.s: अप्य्-अय, coming near, union. See s. v.

अप्यय अप्य्-अय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. इ with अपि, see
अपी), approach, meeting, joining; pouring out; enter-
ing, vanishing; junction; (e. g. स्वाप्यय, entering
into one's self, absorption.)
—अपयय-दीक्षित, अस्, m.,
N. of a Drāviḍa saint and writer, the author of various
works, celebrated as a Śaiva, and thought to be an
incarnation of Śiva; (also अप्याय˚ or अप्यै˚, &c.)
आ-प्याय, अस्, m. becoming full or fat.
1. आप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, obtainable. See आप्तव्य.

2. आप्य, अम्, n., Ved. confederation, alliance, re-
lationship, friendship.

आप्य 4. आप्य, अस्, m. (for आप्त्य), N. of a
class of deities in the sixth Manvantara.

आप्य 5. आप्य, अम्, n., N. of a plant, a kind
of Costus. See वाप्य.

अप्यच् अप्य्-अच्, यङ्, ईची, यक् (rt. अञ्च्),
reaching, gone into, hidden.

अप्यत्यर्ज् अप्य्-अत्य्-अर्ज् (अपि-अति˚), cl. 1. P.,
Ved. -अर्जति, -जितुम्, to add over and above.
अप्य्-अयन, अम्, n. union, joining; copulating.

आप्यायन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing fulness or stout-
ness, increasing welfare; (अम्), n. the act of making
full or fat; satisfying, refreshing, pleasing; satiety,
satisfaction; advancing; anything which causes cor-
pulency or good condition; strengthening medicine;
corpulency, growing or being fat or stout; (in certain
ceremonies) the act of pouring water &c. on the
Soma and so causing it to swell.
—आप्यायन-शील,
अस्, आ, अम्, satisfying.

अप्यर्धम् अप्य्-अर्धम्, ind., Ved. within
proximity, near.

अप्यस् अप्य्-अस् (अपि-अस्), cl. 2. P. -अस्ति, (with
loc. or with an adv. of place) to be in anything; to
be closely connected with, to belong to.
अप्युत अप्य्-उत = अपि and उत, q. v.

आप्यै आ-प्यै, cl. 1. A. -प्यायते, -प्यातुम्,
to grow fat or comfortable, to increase, become full,
enlarge: Caus. P. -प्याययति, -यितुम्, to make fat
or comfortable; to enlarge.
आ-प्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, stout, robust.

आ-प्यायित, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, increased, im-
proved, pleased, gratified; stout, fat.
